title: mytac
summary: tac(1): the lines of standard input in reverse order, with as many lines as the input has.
hints: Keep the lines in an array of `char *` that grows with `realloc` (double the capacity when it is full) and copy each line with `strdup`.
Read with `fgets(buf, 1024, stdin)`. A last line without `\n` still has to be printed on a line of its own.
